column1: # Thai (th) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews; `template` words
#              a template's name on File › New. Both fall back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Scope: the most-seen parts of the interface (the ribbon tabs, the File page, right-click menus).
# The rest shows in English for now; `i18n::thai` lists what is covered.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary Thai
# computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (KhianKrub, PDF, Markdown, Word …) stay in Latin letters.
